          port: 16379
    - to:

              kubernetes.io/metadata.name: kube-system

        - protocol: UDP

          port: 53

    type: RollingUpdate

    matchLabels:
      app: redis
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: redis
    spec:
      enableServiceLinks: false
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 1001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      topologySpreadConstraints:
        - maxSkew: 1
          topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
          whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
          labelSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app: redis
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
            - weight: 100
              podAffinityTerm:
                topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
                labelSelector:

            runAsGroup: 0

            - name: data
              mountPath: /data
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp

        - name: redis
          image: redis:7-alpine
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          securityContext:
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 1001
            runAsGroup: 1001

            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true

            seccompProfile:
              type: RuntimeDefault

            - name: REDIS_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: redis-auth
                  key: password

              valueFrom:

                - |

            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 5

              cpu: "1"
              memory: 2Gi
